$comment: Machine-readable work tracker for fyj_scanner. Migrated from TODO.md. The agent updates `status` and `evidence` as work lands; humans skim `priority` + `phase` to plan. See docs/evaluator-rubric.md for what 'shipped' means.

phases.phase-1: Shared scan layer (cron, scanner, rate limiter, dedup, lifecycle, basic enrichment) — SHIPPED
phases.phase-2: Auth + onboarding + aha moment (Clerk, CV upload, targets, live SQL filter)
phases.phase-3: Per-user matching pipeline + inbox + daily digest
phases.phase-4: On-demand Sonnet A–G deep eval + multi-agent CV-tailor + tracker

statuses.blocked: Cannot proceed without an upstream decision or external dependency.
statuses.deferred: Explicitly decided not to do; reason recorded so we don't relitigate.

features.title: Per-source adaptive rate limiter with block-rate defence
features.verify: select notes from public.scans order by started_at desc limit 1;
features.notes: GH 10·0ms · Ashby 3·200ms · Lever 5·100ms · SR 3·100ms. Halves conc on >5% rolling block-rate.

features.title: GitHub Actions cron + manual dispatch + concurrency group
LLM summary pass (gpt-4o-mini, 14-field schema)
features.next: Drain backlog via `npm run backfill-summaries` (~$14, 25 min). Cron has SKIP_LLM_PASSES=1.
features.verify: select count(*) filter (where description_summary is not null) from jobs where closed_at is null;

features.title: Embedding pass (text-embedding-3-small, 1536d) + HNSW
features.verify: select count(*) filter (where embedding is not null) from jobs where closed_at is null;

features.title: Resume → 14-field summary → embedding → cosine match RPC
features.notes: Symmetric to the JD embedding path. Pulled 30 matches in the 0.74–0.80 cosine band on first run. Cosine ranking is now the stage-1 recall layer beneath the two-stage reranker (f-302); match_resume_candidates returns id+description_summary for the reranker to score.

features.title: Greenhouse 404 recovery (slug-drift heuristic)
features.trigger: 132 of 254 Greenhouse seeds 404'd in the viability run because the slug drifted (e.g. `notion` → `notion-labs`).
features.scope: Try 2–3 slug variants, rewrite companies row if a variant succeeds.

features.title: Expand slug pool beyond HN Algolia
features.current: 2,465 slugs (Greenhouse 883 · Lever 1217 · Ashby 350 · SR 15) + YC workatastartup added.
features.next: GitHub raw README search; curated SmartRecruiters bootstrap list.

features.title: Persist limiter snapshot to structured column
features.scope: Add scans.source_metrics jsonb, parse limiter output from notes once stable, graph block-rate over time.

features.title: Workday adapter
features.scope: Biggest unsupported ATS by enterprise share. JSON API at /wday/cxs/{tenant}/{site}/jobs but URL pattern isn't uniform — needs per-tenant config.

features.title: Title filter at query time (views, not scan time)
features.rationale: Store everything; filter in SQL views so different users can apply different filters without re-scanning.

features.title: Auth + onboarding + aha moment
features.scope: Sign in → CV upload (LLM extract) → targets (LLM expands) → sliders → live SQL filter shows 10 matches in <5 s. See HOSTED_PLATFORM_PLAN.md Phase 2.
features.notes: Early aha-moment slice (résumé upload → matches) already shipped without auth — see f-202. Remaining: auth, persisting CV/targets, sliders.

features.title: Résumé-upload matching UI in the dashboard (/matches)
features.notes: Drag-drop PDF résumé (parsed in-browser via pdf.js → only text sent) → résumé→JD precis → embed → two-stage matcher (f-302) → ranked results with fit score + apply links. Self-contained lib/match.js because the app deploys to Vercel with root=status-page (can't import repo src/ — keep in sync). Live-verified end-to-end. Early, auth-less slice of f-201.

features.title: Location filter + smarter geo matching
features.notes: Location-contains + workplace (remote/hybrid/onsite) controls on /matches. geo.js normalises state name⇄USPS abbrev, country synonyms, and country⇒its-states (so 'United States' matches 'Dallas, TX' / 'Remote (US)'); short tokens match on word boundaries. Filter over-fetches a ~250 cosine pool before rerank — required making match_resume_candidates plpgsql and raising hnsw.ef_search (default 40 silently capped limit 250).

features.title: Protect the public /api/match endpoint
features.reason: Open decision: shared-secret header vs Vercel Deployment Protection. /api/match spends OpenAI tokens per call and is currently unauthenticated.

features.title: Per-user daily matching (SQL filter → Haiku triage → matches table → digest)
features.scope: Inngest fan-out per user. ~$0.005/eval Haiku triage with cached system prompt. Resend daily digest at user-configured time.
features.notes: The per-match ranker this phase needs is already built and validated — see f-302 (pointwise gpt-4o-mini rerank). Remaining: Inngest fan-out, matches table, Resend digest.

features.title: Two-stage matcher: cosine retrieve → gpt-4o-mini pointwise rerank
features.notes: Bake-off winner (f-303). Over-fetch cosine candidates (40–50) then score each résumé↔job fit 0–100 with gpt-4o-mini and reorder. Non-fatal (falls back to cosine on failure / RERANK_ENABLED=0). vs raw cosine: +10.9 meanFit@10, +30 pts recall@10. ~$0.005/query, query-time only. Deployed live behind /matches.

features.title: Match-quality baseline / method bake-off
features.notes: HOSTED_PLATFORM_PLAN Phase 0.4. 10 methods × 3 resumes, graded by an independent gpt-5.1+gpt-5.2 ensemble oracle (inter-judge ρ=0.879). Pointwise LLM rerank wins; cheap gpt-4o-mini ties gpt-4.1; 3-large, field-chunking, and listwise rerank all underperform; lexical skill-overlap is the strongest non-LLM signal (→ candidate hybrid-retrieval feed, deferred). Also fixed a selectAll limit bug (~46× cost) found en route.

features.title: On-demand Sonnet A–G deep evaluation
features.scope: User clicks 'evaluate' → full A–G report (~$0.15 with prompt caching) → writes reports row.

features.title: Multi-agent CV-tailor pipeline
features.scope: Planner (Sonnet) → 4 parallel writers (Promise.all) → assembled draft → Haiku ATS audit → Sonnet polisher → markdown → Browserless PDF. 7 LLM calls · ~$0.08 per CV. See docs/architecture.excalidraw § D.

features.title: Applications tracker (kanban)
features.scope: applications table + Next.js /tracker page; statuses from templates/states.yml.

features.title: Apply flow v1 (deep-link to ATS)
features.scope: Mark applications.status='applied'; surface tailored PDF + cover for copy-paste.

features.title: Cross-company dedup (parent/subsidiary)
features.reason: Needs entity resolution on company names + a company_group table. Defer until query 5 (top employers) actually shows obvious dupes in week-1 data.

features.title: Workable adapter
features.reason: No public JSON API; needs Playwright HTML-scrape (fragile + dep). Viability test was 0/104 success. Revisit if high-value Workable companies become priority.

features.title: Title filtering at scan time
features.reason: Would force everyone to share one filter and lose data. Filter at query time instead (see f-105).

features.title: Vacuum old probe_results
features.trigger: probe_results > 500k rows. At 4 scans/day × 3k companies ≈ 12k/day = 4.4M/year if unbounded.
features.scope: Keep last 90 days, archive the rest via SQL function.
